purpose: Diagnose the errors of the retained shallow-student ensemble to choose the next substantive intervention; no new architecture/seed/forecast training in this study.
user_direction: Analyze model errors instead of more seed/serving iterations.

predictions.components: four current members; shallow seed4 individual for fixed diagnostic disagreement features only

metric.error_budget: For each target, globally weighted-standardize clipped y and each clipped model prediction. Each group contributes one quarter of the target-wise weighted squared standardized differences divided by the global target weight. Groups sum exactly to 1-WP.

extraction.scored_row_table: float32 y2, eight prediction pairs, thirty causal summaries; integer sequence/row/chain/fold/retrospective-class identifiers
extraction.chain_Gram: float64[250,2,261,261], target-specific |clip(y)| weights, exact feature registry stored with result
Gram_features: normalized current model input211 from fixed same-fold training normalizers
extraction.events: At most64 observed encoded i0 joint-price-change anchors per sequence, selected independently of labels by fixed linspace. Offsets -32,-8,-1,0,1,4,16,64; retain masks, raw-code and model-output anchor directions. Retrospective event-aligned sample, not a causal feature or oracle predictor.

diagnostics.probe: Cross-fitted linear prediction of the fit-defined normalized post-clip metric-gradient component q=(u-rho*z)/sqrt(1-rho^2). Not a forecast candidate or an estimate of attainable WP gain.
diagnostics.probe_splits: Two deterministic chain halves within each outer fold, seed20261001; two-way crossfit. Stratify by retrospective class only for split balance; class/chain/sequence IDs excluded from predictor features.
diagnostics.probe_fit: Every q mean/SD/rho and weighted X centering/scale estimated only from the fitting chains. One ridge lambda0.01 on normalized weighted Gram; no tuning. Heldout SSE uses fitting constants and training-mean constant baseline.
diagnostics.probe_uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-chain bootstrap draws stratified by fold and inner half, conditional on the fitted probes; no seed/selection/domain-shift uncertainty claim.
diagnostics.event_response: Signed response and residual/gradient around observed input-code events; report both folds/targets and retrospective classes. No future-prediction shift score, event-time oracle, physical-price interpretation, or causal-effect claim from event curves alone.

small_generated_checks: Exact deficit/group additivity and baseline WP reconstruction
Leakage-safe ridge algebra, planted available signal and independent-noise control
Event offset/alignment and distinction between causal input features and retrospective anchor selection
decision_rule: Rank mechanisms by error mass, conditional predictability, fold robustness, historical counterevidence and intervention cost. No universal significance/gain cutoff; negative linear probes do not establish an irreducible-noise ceiling. Freeze any subsequent training experiment separately.
outputs: event-response plots with honest selection scope
concise diagnosis and at most three testable next interventions, each tied to evidence
publication: local and beleriand only; no GitHub or public submission
